title: Rockstar finally responds to ‘heartbreaking’ GTA 6 leaks
summary: Rockstar Games responded to widespread Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay leaks, calling the situation "heartbreaking for our team" and apologizing for delays in finishing the game and sharing official details. The statement marks the company's first official comment on the leaked footage that has circulated online.
content:
Rockstar Games has released its first official statement following days of sustained leaks of footage from Grand Theft Auto VI, calling the period "heartbreaking for our team."
"It would be an understatement to say that having videos of Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay leak in this way has been heartbreaking for our team, and this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time," the studio said in a statement published today on social media. zh.title: 洛克星游戏公司终于回应"令人心碎"的侠盗猎车手6泄漏事件
zh.summary: 洛克星游戏公司回应了广泛传播的《侠盗猎车手VI》游戏玩法泄漏，称这种情况对他们的团队来说"令人心碎"，并为游戏完成和公布官方细节的延迟道歉。这份声明是该公司对在网上流传的泄漏片段的首次官方评论。

title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
summary: Legato, a hearing technology startup, emerged from stealth with $12 million in funding and unveiled Legato Frames, AI-powered hearing glasses that integrate hearing-assistance technology into eyewear. The device represents a new category of wearable technology for accessibility and hearing enhancement.
content: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.

zh.title: 听力技术初创公司Legato融资1200万美元脱离隐身，推出AI听力眼镜
zh.summary: 听力技术初创公司Legato以1200万美元融资脱离隐身状态，并推出了Legato Frames听力眼镜，这是一款人工智能驱动的眼镜，将听力辅助技术集成到眼镜中。该设备代表了一个新的可穿戴技术类别，用于无障碍和听力增强。

title: The second-generation Bose QuietComfort Headphones are good, but don’t stand out
summary: Bose released the second-generation QuietComfort Headphones at $359, but reviewers say they fail to differentiate in a competitive market where Sony and Apple have surpassed Bose in noise-canceling performance. Budget alternatives like the Soundcore Space 2 offer comparable features at significantly lower prices.
content:
The Bose QuietComfort Headphones Gen 2 look a lot like all other Bose headphones from the past few years.	

Bose QuietComfort headphones used to be innovative. Bose's noise-canceling research is the reason the technology is where it is today, and its headphones set the standard. They were the ubiquitous traveler's accessory. But over the past few years, it's felt like Bose has rested on that reputation, as other companies have caught up. Sony and Apple have both surpassed Bose in noise-canceling performance, and even midrange headphones like the $130 Soundcore Space 2 are close for much less money. That means the $359 Bose QuietComfort Headphones 2nd Gen need to stand out in other ways - and I don't think they do.

zh.title: 第二代Bose QuietComfort耳机不错，但没有突出表现
zh.summary: Bose以359美元的价格发布了第二代QuietComfort耳机，但评论家表示它们在竞争激烈的市场中缺乏差异化，索尼和苹果的降噪性能已超越Bose。Soundcore Space 2等预算选项以更低的价格提供相似功能。

title: IBM's new Granite 4.2 models ride the wave of interest in local LLMs
summary: IBM released Granite 4.2 models focused on agentic capabilities and predictable enterprise deployment, capitalizing on growing demand for local LLMs. The models target enterprises seeking on-premise AI solutions with improved reasoning and controllability.
content: The focus is on agentic capability and predictable enterprise deployment.

zh.title: IBM的新Granite 4.2模型乘上本地LLM热潮
zh.summary: IBM发布了Granite 4.2模型，专注于代理能力和可预测的企业部署，利用对本地LLM日益增长的需求。这些模型针对寻求具有改进推理和可控性的本地AI解决方案的企业。

title: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he’s no longer staying quiet
summary: Bill Gates, once a prominent AI optimist, published a nearly 6,000-word essay warning that the world is fundamentally unprepared for the rapidly approaching "turbulent AI era." The Microsoft cofounder has shifted from silence to actively seeking influence in global AI policy decisions.
content:
Bill Gates, chair of the Gates Foundation, speaks during a 2024 conference. | Bloomberg via Getty Images	

Bill Gates has been reflecting a lot on AI lately, and the process has triggered a stark awakening. Once a staunch AI optimist, the Microsoft cofounder is now deeply pessimistic about what AI means for our collective future. 
Having been conspicuously quiet on AI issues recently, Gates is back with a nearly 6,000-word essay seeking to reclaim a central role in shaping the technology globally. Titled "The turbulent AI era is here. The choices we make now are critical," Gates warns the world is not remotely ready for what is coming. Worse still, he notes, "we are not preparing for it." 
Gates attempts to chart a path forward, but the essay l …

zh.title: 比尔·盖茨对AI深感担忧，不再保持沉默
zh.summary: 曾经是AI乐观派的比尔·盖茨发表了一篇近6000字的文章，警告世界对即将到来的"动荡AI时代"从根本上毫无准备。这位微软联合创始人已从沉默转变为积极寻求在全球AI政策决策中的影响力。

title: Xtracycle's Swoop ASM e-bike brings an automatic transmission to cargo bikes
summary: Xtracycle introduced the Swoop ASM cargo bike, which features an automatic transmission system that automatically selects gears for riders. The innovation brings gear automation technology to the cargo bike category, simplifying the user experience for electric cargo bikes.
content: A steel frame cargo bike with a unique twist: You can let it choose your gear.

zh.title: Xtracycle的Swoop ASM电动自行车为货运自行车带来自动变速
zh.summary: Xtracycle推出了Swoop ASM货运自行车，配备自动变速系统，可为骑手自动选择齿轮。这项创新为货运自行车类别带来了齿轮自动化技术，简化了电动货运自行车的用户体验。

title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
summary: Runable raised $21 million in funding as it expands AI agent applications from business creation to business growth and scaling. The company reports strong monetization, with 60-70% of its trillion-plus token usage in the past 90 days coming from paying customers.
content: Runable says 60%–70% of its 1 trillion-plus token usage in the last 90 days came from paying customers.

zh.title: Runable融资2100万美元，押注AI代理能从创建企业发展到促进企业增长
zh.summary: Runable获得2100万美元融资，扩展AI代理应用从业务创建到业务增长和扩展。该公司报告称变现能力强劲，过去90天内其超过万亿token使用量的60-70%来自付费客户。

title: Ikea’s Xbox collection includes a giant thumbstick stool
summary: Ikea partnered with Microsoft to launch the Yxstaby collection, a nine-piece gaming-inspired furniture line celebrating Xbox's 25th anniversary. The collection blends functional furniture pieces with decorative items themed around Xbox controller design elements.
content:
Some pieces in the Yxstaby collection are more obviously Xbox-inspired than others. | Image: Ikea	

Ikea has teamed up with Microsoft to launch a new assortment of gaming-inspired furniture and home accessories, coinciding with the 25th anniversary of the first Xbox console. The nine-piece Yxstaby collection (good luck pronouncing that) includes a TV stand, laptop stand, side table, lounge chair, and multi-functional toolbox, with standout products like a stool, cushion, decorative platter, and mirrored display box being specifically designed around recognizable Xbox controller motifs.
The Yxstaby range makes it easier to "bring play into a room and tuck everything away afterwards," according to Ikea's press release, with each piece creat …

zh.title: 宜家Xbox系列包括一个巨大的摇杆凳
zh.summary: 宜家与微软合作推出Yxstaby系列，这是一个九件套游戏主题家具系列，庆祝Xbox成立25周年。该系列融合了功能性家具和以Xbox控制器设计元素为主题的装饰品。

title: Ventures Platform goes bigger — and broader — with its second Africa fund
summary: Ventures Platform, a Pan-African venture firm, raised $84 million for its second fund and plans to expand investment beyond its home market of Nigeria into other African markets. The larger fund positions the firm to pursue broader geographic and sectoral investment strategies across the continent.
content: The Pan-African venture firm has raised $84 million and plans to invest in startups beyond its home market of Nigeria.

zh.title: Ventures Platform通过第二个非洲基金实现规模和范围的扩大
zh.summary: 泛非风险投资公司Ventures Platform为其第二只基金筹集8400万美元，计划将投资范围从本土市场尼日利亚扩展到其他非洲市场。更大规模的基金使该公司能够在整个非洲大陆实施更广泛的地理和行业投资战略。

title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
summary: Ringg has secured $10 million in Series A extension funding from Peak XV to advance its voice AI technology beyond traditional phone call applications. The investment supports the company's mission to expand voice AI capabilities in the broader market.
content: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.

zh.title: 印度语音AI公司Ringg获Peak XV支持，拓展应用范围超越电话通话
zh.summary: Ringg公司从Peak XV获得1000万美元A轮扩展融资，推进其语音AI技术超越传统电话通话应用。该投资支持公司拓展语音AI在更广泛市场中的应用能力。

title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
summary: Robotics startup Generalist has reached a $3 billion valuation following a $200 million funding extension, demonstrating strong investor confidence in physical AI technology just months after achieving a $2 billion valuation. The milestone highlights accelerating funding momentum in the robotics sector.
content: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

zh.title: 机器人初创公司Generalist估值达30亿美元，知情人士称
zh.summary: 机器人初创公司Generalist在获得2亿美元融资扩展后，估值达到30亿美元，这表明投资者对物理AI技术充满信心，距该公司实现20亿美元估值仅几个月。这一里程碑凸显了机器人行业融资动力的加速。

title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
summary: OpenAI has lost a top data center executive as part of ongoing high-profile departures from the company. The departure follows an organizational reshuffle of OpenAI's infrastructure division under new leadership.
content: Before Malone left, OpenAI had already reshuffled its infrastructure org, shifting his reporting line away from President Greg Brockman and putting Vice President Sachin Katti in charge of the group.

zh.title: OpenAI失去数据中心高管，高层离职潮继续
zh.summary: OpenAI在继续出现高层离职的情况下，失去了一名数据中心高管。此次离职发生在新领导下OpenAI基础设施部门进行组织重组之后。
